user_choice: 2026-10-02: retain 15% workforce above planning capacity; state 20% and country 15% reduction limits presented and accepted.
rules: Apply once to original source-derived starting population; never to a running save and never repeatedly compound cuts.
Capacity is 75% of productive formal jobs, 100% of owner-building jobs, plus available subsistence jobs. Workforce ratio is 25%.
Desired workforce is at least 115% of capacity, subject to conservative state/country reduction caps; caps can leave a larger surplus.
Reduce total population groups proportionally, rather than deleting workers while leaving their dependents. Game initialization determines workforce and professions.
Template fallback people are preserved. Do not transfer people between states, countries, cultures or religions.
Round retained groups upwards, preserve at least one person, and leave each literacy selector/rate unchanged.
Preserve local aristocrat/capitalist staffing pools for existing manor/financial ownership. Preserve strict culture/religion majority status at state-country and whole-state scope.
Keep buildings, ownership, land/resources, diplomacy, laws and military establishments unchanged. Lower tax base may worsen budgets; no fiscal balance guarantee.
